# Draft:Jiexiu ware

----
Jiexiu ware (Chinese: 介休窑) is a type of Chinese ceramic produced in Jiexiu, Shanxi Province, primarily during the Song, Jin, and Yuan dynasties. The main kiln sites are located at Hongshan, Jiexiu County, and the ware is sometimes referred to as Hongshan ware (洪山窑). The kilns were known for white-glazed wares with impressed, incised, or painted decoration, showing strong influence from Ding ware in neighboring Hebei. Jiexiu ware is considered one of the most important products of the 'Ding ware system' (定窑系) in northern China.
